system.description:
Artificial lungs that keep the body oxygenated. Common: +2k0 on Tests against gas weapons and toxins carried in the air.

Poor: same bonus, but the noisy system imposes -2k0 on Stealth tests involving sound and every Test of strenuous physical effort needs an extra raise to succeed. Good: acts as full life support if the natural respiratory system fails, and can be built to go unnoticed. Best adds no further benefit beyond Good.
system.effectText: +2k0 vs airborne toxins/gas. Poor: -2k0 sound Stealth, strenuous tests need extra raise. Good: full life support.
